map.r_s=2GM/c²=2·6.674×10⁻¹¹·1.989×10³⁰/(2.9: r_s = 2GM/c^2 = 2 x 6.674 x 10^-11 x 1.989 x 10^30 / (2.998 x 10^8)^2, about 2.95 x 10^3 m, about 2.95 km. That is, the Sun would have to be compressed into a sphere of about 3 km radius to become a black hole, while the Earth would need to be compressed to about 9 mm.
map.是黑洞的单向边界：其内的光也无法逃逸，外界只能看到视界外的信息，故称「事件视界」: It is the one-way boundary of a black hole: light inside it cannot escape either, and outside observers can only see information from beyond the horizon, hence the name event horizon.
map.质量越大视界越大还是越小？: Does a larger mass mean a larger or a smaller horizon?
map.越大。r_s 与质量成正比，太阳级黑洞约 3 km，超大质量黑洞（如星系中心）可: Larger. r_s is proportional to the mass: a solar-mass black hole is about 3 km, while a supermassive black hole such as one at a galactic centre can reach tens of millions of kilometres.
